user_prompt: Audit product stock levels from the database against category thresholds in config.json and write an inventory alert report.

steps.thought: I need to query the current stock levels of all products from the database.

arguments.query: SELECT id, name, category, stock_quantity FROM products;

steps.thought: I have the product stock levels. Now I must read the category threshold limits from 'data/config.json'.

Backup Appliance (Hardware) has stock 4 < threshold 5. Security Suite Pro (Security) has stock 8 < threshold 10. Database Cluster B has stock 12 < threshold 15. I will write an inventory alert report.

arguments.content:
LOW INVENTORY ALERTS:
- Database Cluster B (Infrastructure): Stock 12 < Min 15
- Security Suite Pro (Security): Stock 8 < Min 10
- Backup Appliance (Hardware): Stock 4 < Min 5

steps.thought: The inventory analysis is complete and the alert file has been persisted.
steps.final_answer: Inventory audit completed: 3 items are below threshold (Database Cluster B: 12/15, Security Suite Pro: 8/10, Backup Appliance: 4/5). Alert report saved to 'data/inventory_alerts.txt'.

final_answer: Inventory audit completed: 3 items are below threshold (Database Cluster B: 12/15, Security Suite Pro: 8/10, Backup Appliance: 4/5). Alert report saved to 'data/inventory_alerts.txt'.
